correctness.rationale: Two exact p-dependent normalizations to a fixed binomial column, both with unit-affine variable, are proved by factorial identities and Kummer scaling. Digit carry matrix and geometric tail give a normalized rational law with exact finite-cylinder natural densities. The mean is the sum of carry probabilities; a decisive final digit excludes the unique p-power predecessor period for each capped threshold. Exact checker validates 59040 assertions including 352 complete prime-power histograms; finite tests are support, not the unrestricted proof.

value.rationale: Arity is an independent enumerative parameter in the established Fuss–Catalan family. The theorem provides a complete exact arithmetic distribution for every fixed size and every prime, together with digit-sum expectation, explicit nondivisibility density, and least periods at every valuation threshold; the nontrivial p-divisibility normalization split and arbitrary-digit carry interactions make this a natural uniform classification rather than an arbitrary slice or routine pointwise restatement.
